simple: Breaks into other people’s websites, servers, domains, or routers and attacks from them — so the trail leads to innocent owners.
analogy: A thief hides tools in the neighbor’s shed so suspicion falls on the neighbor.
quote: The attack came from a well-known company’s server, and we weren’t even blocking it
questions: Do you get data on compromised addresses and domains?
Do you inspect traffic even to “trusted” sites?
